description: How lib/read-readme.mjs reads a README that words its headings differently from handoff-schema/README.template.md. headings: a template heading and the words a README heading may begin with instead (whole words, case and punctuation ignored); an exact template heading always wins, and a README heading that two templates accept goes to the first in template order. labels: the words in a sub-heading, a bold line or a `Label:` line that put the items under it in the judgement calls list or the open items list (whole words, anywhere in the label; an open word wins over a decision word).
